name: Emancipation
overview: The biblical concept of emancipation is closely tied to the Year of Jubilee, a sacred time occurring every fifty years when liberty is proclaimed throughout the land. During this year, as outlined in Leviticus 25:8-13, every individual is to return to their own possession and family, and the land is to rest from sowing and reaping. This divine ordinance ensured the release of Jewish servants and restoration of property, emphasizing God's provision and holiness in granting freedom and renewal to His people.
